welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.text: Three questions and OpenFamily is ready. Everything asked here can be changed later in Settings.

family.title: Who is in the family?
family.text: Add the people of the household, with or without an account. A date of birth puts the birthday in the calendar.

modules.title: What does your family need?
modules.text: Untick what you will not use: it leaves the menu, and comes back whenever you want from Settings.

done.title: It is ready
done.text: Your family is set up. Three things worth doing next:
done.tipInvite: Invite the other adults from the Family page, so that each has their own sign-in.
done.tipPhone: Put OpenFamily on your phones: the Android app, or "Add to home screen" from the browser.
done.tipHome: Arrange your home page with the "Customise" button: each member has their own.

error: Something could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
